messages.subject: Movement model selection and ΔAICc
parts: Hello, I want to use AKDEs to analyze Blanding's turtle movement and space use. When two movement models give an ΔAICc <2, how does the ctmm.select choose between the best two models? Here are all of the movement models ctmm.select ran with data from one of my turtles. How should I decide between the best two models? Thank you!

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Movement model selection and ΔAICc
parts:
Hi,

By default, ctmm selects the lowest AIC model. In this case, the two AIC-best models have the same number of parameters. When the AIC values are close, you can check that the outputs are similar (e.g., area and diffusion rate). Typically they are.

Best,
Chris
